title: Google launches experimental game creation platform Playground
excerpt: The browser-based platform allows users to build and share custom games using text prompts without requiring coding experience.
bodyHtml:
Google announced the launch of Playground, an experimental gaming platform, on October 7, 2026. The service allows users to create, play, and share custom games through a conversational interface that interprets text prompts to generate characters, rules, and environments.

The platform is available to users in the U.S. aged 18 and older at playground.google, with access tiers determined by Google AI subscriptions. Users can publish games to a community gallery or share them via links, with support for multiplayer gameplay and leaderboards in certain genres.

Google stated that an integration with Unity Spark is planned for the future to provide professional-level mechanics and 3D capabilities. Unity Spark is currently in testing, with a closed beta scheduled to arrive soon.
